config.GT_policy: all64 predictions and receipts sealed before labels; no GT selects parameters, observations, stopping or permutation
config.attention: per-head/query same-frame legal visual-token redistribution preserving visual attention mass; text unchanged directly
config.auxiliary_track: full_timeline BoxFixed with original scoring weights and explicit all-node/all-edge support; no Strong event or activity mask
config.expert_evidence: same selected ReferDINO query, boxes and native mask logits; exact cached evidence reused
config.final_decode: one final BoxFixed DP in each method's own predicted interval; no iteration
config.fixed_spatial_time_analysis: reuse the same A_Strong spatial trajectory with all four predicted intervals
config.permutation: fixed cyclic half-shift among each frame's legal visual tokens; preserve weight histogram, r and temporal support
config.reliability: existing interval-independent correspondence reliability; invalid evidence contributes zero
config.selection: first64 HC development-manifest parents; one query per parent; unchanged order
config.space: original complete-box BoxFixed fixed score and exact DP; no OPD or optimizer

costs.A_reference: Predictions are reused; this run does not remeasure a64-query Strong end-to-end latency. Historical A timings are not treated as matched current costs.
costs.scope: Shared224 capture is measured once per query; component totals add that measured shared cost to each measured branch finish, excluding shared output-cache IO. Multi-branch trial wall includes all B/C/D work and IO; it is not one deployed method latency. Expert evidence hits and new native224 misses are reported separately. No predeclared speedup multiplier is assumed.
